population: Expanded-lattice / AABB supercell volumes (calibrated on FoldKit multi-copy S-layer lattices; use for any expanded lattice, not only S-layers)
rounding: Matthews on a 0.5 grid; solvent and packing upper edges on a 5-unit grid. Packing lower edge uses a 1%-point grid when a 5-point grid would collapse a positive minimum to zero. Solvent limits derived from Matthews endpoints via FoldKit 0.81 Da/A3 heuristic, then rounded outward.
notes: Fixed expanded-lattice bands replacing the former crystal×f inflation. Mode name 'bbox' signals general supercell use; the calibration cohort is experimental S-layers until a non-S-layer expanded cohort is available.
Estimated solvent% is algebraically linked to Matthews via solvent = 100*(1 - 1/(0.81*VM)).
Bands: Matthews 8–45, solvent 80–100%, packing 2–15% (nonzero packing floor; assembled lattices are never empty).
